title: Does HubSpot Have a Sales Coach? Coaching Tools, Free Training and AI Practice
summary: Does HubSpot have a sales coach? What Sales Hub offers for coaching, what HubSpot Academy teaches free, and where AI roleplay fits for HubSpot teams.
body_markdown:
What to test


How to run it


Score 0, 1 or 2


Deal context


Connect HubSpot and check the buyer knows the account, deal stage and last call.


0 if generic, 2 if it uses your HubSpot deal


Buyer pushback


Two senior reps run the scenario and rate whether the buyer resisted like a real one.


0 if the buyer folds, 2 if reps say it matched


Voice


Run a full spoken call, not a typed exchange.


0 if typed only, 2 if spoken with natural turn-taking


Your criteria


Load your own criteria and check that feedback cites the moment behind each score.


0 if generic, 2 if your criteria with evidence


Retry one moment


Ask the rep to replay only the moment they missed.


0 if full restart only, 2 if they can start at the moment


Setup time


Time from kickoff to the first assigned scenario.


0 if more than a week, 2 if the same day


Real-call change


Tag the same moment in HubSpot call review on each rep's next real calls.


0 if no change, 2 if the miss is gone on most calls


Cost


Get a written quote for the seats you would roll out.


0 if it needs a tier you would not otherwise buy, 2 if it fits the budget
